notes.en: Fixed: Settings no longer says you are in demo mode when you are not. Firmware updates for the CR5 series use update patches only; if the backup on the watch does not match, this version does not send the full firmware yet. Please update to this version before updating watch firmware.
notes.zh-TW: 修正：在一般模式下，設定頁不再誤寫「目前是展示模式」。CR5 系列的韌體更新只使用差分；手錶上的備份對不上時，這一版先不傳完整韌體。開放韌體更新前，請先更新到這一版。
